_comment: The scrim styles the YouTube TV app can put on ytlr-player, and the class
each maps to. Taken verbatim from the shipped bundle's own Fkb map in
main.js -- this list is the app's, not ours, which is the point: a scrim
style added by a later version arrives here when the capture is refreshed,
and the harness renders it whether or not anyone thought to.
main.js template `alb` applies `Vdm04` plus one of these classes to
ytlr-player when a scrim style is set and loadedPlaybackConfig.mode is 2
or 3. Empty lists (UNKNOWN, NONE) paint nothing.
`coversInStock` names the classes that hide the video even with
app-quality-root present, so the mod is not blamed for them:
app-quality-root only RECOLOURS TbjVGf, #030303 to #0f0f0f, rather than
